messages.subject: One tabPanel affecting another
parts:
Hello!

I have multiple tabPanels and the first one reacts to an actionButton and the second generates a leaflet map. When the first tabPanel is not there (i.e., commented out), the second tabPanel generates the map and successful implements the 'addLayersControl' function, allowing the user to click on and off different layers (i.e., polygon). However, when the first tabPanel is made active (uncommented), the second one no longer works properly. In other words, the addLayersControl is automatically 'clicked on' and no layers appear. Here's a bit of the code (I've tried to provide enough code to see what's going on):

ui.R
Logged = FALSE;
my_username <- "username"
my_password <- "password"
ui <- shinyUI(navbarPage("W", id="nav",
        tabPanel("Login",value="log",
                      hidden(
                        div(id = "login",
                          wellPanel(textInput("userName","Username"),
                                  passwordInput("passwd","Password"),
                                  br(),actionButton("Login","Log in"))),
                      tags$style(type="text/css", "#login {font-size:14px;   text-align: left;position:absolute;top: 40%;left: 50%;margin-top: -100px;margin-left: -150px;}")
                      ),
                      hidden(
                        p(id="startText","Start by exploring the 'Interactive map' tab!"),
                        tags$style(type="text/css", "#startText {font-size:25px;   text-align: left;position:absolute;top: 40%;left: 50%;margin-top: -100px;margin-left: -150px;}")
                        )
                      ),
tabPanel("Interactive map",value="tabMap",
                            tags$div(class="outer",
                                leafletOutput("map", width="100%", height="100%"),
                ),
       ))

server.r
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
   USER <- reactiveValues(Logged=Logged)
   observe({
     if (USER$Logged == FALSE) {
       if (!is.null(input$Login)) {
         if (input$Login > 0) {
           Username <- isolate(input$userName)
           Password <- isolate(input$passwd)
           Id.username <- which(my_username == Username)
           Id.password <- which(my_password == Password)
           if (length(Id.username) > 0 & length(Id.password) > 0) {
             if (Id.username == Id.password) {
               USER$Logged <- TRUE
             } 
           }
         } 
       }
     }    
   })
   
 observeEvent(USER$Logged,{
     toggle(selector="#nav li a[data-value=tabMap]")
     toggle(selector="#nav li a[data-value=tabExplorer]")
     toggle(selector="#nav li a[data-value=tabRisk]")
     toggle(selector="#nav li a[data-value=tabAbout]")
     show("login")
     if(USER$Logged==TRUE){
       toggle(selector="#nav li a[data-value=log]")
       hide("login")
       show("startText")
     }
   })
observe({  
    output$map <- renderLeaflet({
      leaflet() %>%
        addProviderTiles("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap") %>%
        setView(lng = -74.2890, lat = 43.3582,zoom=input$zoom) %>%
          addLayersControl(position="topleft",
            overlayGroups=c("Water Use","HUC 8"),
            options=layersControlOptions(collapsed=TRUE)
          )
       })
  })
  
  #Read in HUC layer
  observe({
      test <- shapefile("data/USGShu8.036.shp.7314/NY_HUC250k.shp")
      leafletProxy("map",data=test) %>% 
      addPolygons(fill=FALSE,stroke=TRUE,color="#03F",group="HUC 8")%>%
      setView(lng = -74.2890, lat = 43.3582, zoom = input$zoom)%>%
      hideGroup("HUC 8")
      #addLegend("bottomright",colors="#03F",labels=paste("HUC",input$huc))
  })
})

The bolded code is the part that doesn't work. Do you know why this may be happening?

Thanks in advance!
Sarah

messages.subject: Re: One tabPanel affecting another
parts: I thought I would refine my question. After further investigation, I believe the problem is in this piece of the code:

output$map <- renderLeaflet({
      leaflet() %>%
        addProviderTiles("Esri.NatGeoWorldMap") %>%
        setView(lng = -74.2890, lat = 43.3582,zoom=input$zoom) %>%
          addLayersControl(position="topleft",
            overlayGroups=c("Water Use","HUC 8"),
            options=layersControlOptions(collapsed=TRUE)
          )
       })

It only is triggered when input$zoom is changed, but I would like it to execute as soon as this part of the code occurs (i.e., as soon as updateTabsetPanel occurs):

if(USER$Logged==TRUE){
      updateTabsetPanel(session, 'nav', 'tabMap')
      toggle(selector="#nav a[data-value=log]")
      hide("login")
    }

*Note: The above code was changed slightly from the original post to toggle to the next tabPanel instead of displaying text. 

Thanks,
Sarah
